name: ARTBITRAGE Catalogue
description: The catalogue and data distributor of the art world. Open-access works, no gate, no key, free.

wings.title: Arms & Armor
wings.description: Steel made ceremonial — parade armors, jeweled daggers, and helmets that were never meant to see battle, only awe.

wings.title: Cosmos
wings.description: Moons, comets, and star-strewn skies — the heavens as artists have charted and dreamed them.

wings.title: Dreams & the Nocturnal
wings.description: Works made at the threshold of sleep — visions, moonlit hours, and the images the mind paints when the eyes close.

wings.title: Flowers
wings.description: Petals pressed into permanence — bouquets, blossoms, and botanical dreams from East and West.

wings.title: Gold
wings.description: Everything gilded: icons on gold ground, hoarded treasure, and the gleam that painters borrowed from heaven.

wings.title: Light
wings.description: Dawns, candle flames, and gilded halos — the art of light catching the world before it moves on.

wings.title: Love
wings.description: Every era has reached for the same warmth — the kiss, the embrace, the god with the arrow.

wings.title: Myth & Monster
wings.description: Gods, dragons, demons and sphinxes — the creatures humanity dreamed before it dared to explain itself.

wings.title: The Sea
wings.description: The sea in all its moods — from Hokusai's cresting fury to the hush of harbor light.

wings.title: The Blue Room: Hue Wings
wings.description: Rooms built purely from math — every wall here glows between hue 200 and 260, joined by the loudest, most colorfully saturated works the machines could find.

wings.title: The Highlights Vault
wings.description: Only the anointed: works three great museums each swore were the ones you must not miss.

wings.title: The Music Hall
wings.description: Stradivari lacquer, ivory horns, gilded harpsichords — the instruments fall silent, and still the room hums.
